notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
- Fixed issue where player can pass through Dr. Singh vertically
- Fixed player speed bugs
- Fixed issue where Craig can walk off the ladder on the 4th floor
- Fixed issue where Craig can walk through Dr. Singh's desk
- Fixed issue where Craig can walk into the water in the basement

Quality of Life fixes:
- Reset the ladder's coordinates on the 7th floor when player leaves map

Gameplay Adjustments:
- Reduced encounter rate on all maps
- Reduced enemy damage attributes
- Improved SMG damage

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
Minor graphical fixes:
- Corrected jumping animations on 1st floor
- Corrected jumping animations on 4th floor
- Corrected giant crab path under falling rocket ship pieces
- Fixed glitch that caused Craig to climb on pipe sideways
- Fixed giant crab death animation
- Fixed fence panel that was placed in error in the swimming section of the basement

Quality of life fixes:
- Added comic panels to intro scene
- Added additional comic panel to 1st sea scorpion encounter
- Added additional comic panel to archaeopteryx encounter

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
The following fixes are now live:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed sprite issues while climbing pipes in stairwell
- Fixed bug that allowed the player to walk past the glass on the first floor

Gameplay fixes:
- Reduced encounter rate throughout
- Reduced damage from orthoceras enemy
- Reduced damage from carpopenaeus enemies

Misc fixes:
- Archaeopteryx enemy was incorrectly called oviraptor. Have updated the references to the correct name

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Based on feedback from players, I've made the following fixes:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed collision issues in stairwell
- Fixed bug causing game to lock when opening the office door from 5th floor hallway
- Fixed a typo in door message text

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi! Based on bug reports and feedback from players, I've made the following changes for 1.0.2
 
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed bug that caused some players to encounter the tutorial mid-game
- Fixed a collision issue with the ladders in the lab
- Adjusted collision for Nodosaurus and Chasmosaurus on 4th floor
- Fixed foreground pipes in basement level
- Fixed bug that caused Chasmosaurus to respond to pizza when he was in another room

Quality Improvements:
- Adjusted RNG on some enemy attacks
- Adjusted accuracy for guns
- Reduced encounter rate in areas
- Adjusted difficulty of Compy encounters

notes.title: Day One Hotfix - Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed issue with certain monitors freezing
- Fixed bug in endgame scoring
- Lowered evasion rate on Utahraptor enemies
